Pull the full CCLD facility detail for one license

Source: R/ccld_facility.R
ccld_facility.Rd

Returns the facility detail fields exposed by the Transparency API, plus nested list-columns for evaluation reports and itemized complaints. Use tidyr::unnest() to flatten either list-column after inspecting the scalar facility fields.

Usage

ccld_facility(facnum, cache = TRUE)

Arguments

facnum

A single facility license number, character or numeric. Accepts 8- or 9-digit forms; padded internally via ccld_pad().

cache

Logical value (default TRUE) controlling whether the on-disk response cache is used.

Value

A one-row tibble with scalar facility fields and list-columns reports and complaints.

Details

ccld_facility() is intentionally scalar: pass one facility license number at a time. Use ccld_verify() first when you need to screen a vector of candidate licenses. Unknown facilities raise a ccldr_not_found error.

See also

ccld_verify() to check whether licenses exist before requesting full detail.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ccld_facility("13423996")
} # }
